checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs ~10 seconds
All five photos appear recognizably in order
must.why: Sampled frames show storefront, pastries (mid-transition), barista, interior. The latte frame was not sampled, and the pastries/storefront are regenerated and differ from the originals.

must.item: Each photo has enough screen time
must.why: Four sampled frames fall on different shots, which suggests about 2 s each. I could not verify the latte or exact timing.

must.item: Relaxed instrumental music audible, no speech
must.why: Audio is present with a peak of -3 dB, but I cannot judge its content.

must.item: Smooth transitions and no added text
must.why: No text is visible. The pastries frame shows a circular, ghosted dissolve-like transition that looks a bit odd but not harsh.

faults.what: The storefront was regenerated by an AI model. It is extended vertically with a large empty road and differs from the original photo.

The pastries shot is regenerated and differs from the original. The barista is gone from behind the counter and the croissants have changed. A visible circular ghost overlay from the transition appears at 4.1 s.
The barista and interior shots look AI-generated, with a possible face and person warp in the interior. They cannot be verified against the user's photos.
The latte frame was not visible in the samples, so I could not confirm the latte photo appears.

summary: The reel is a 10 s vertical AI-generated video with audio and no text, but the shots are regenerated rather than the actual photos. The storefront and pastries visibly differ from the originals, the transition has an odd circular ghost, and the latte could not be confirmed.
